svg.title: Three small slope fields labelled A, B and C, each for x and y from minus 1 to 3. In A the segments along each row are parallel, horizontal on the row y equals 1, rising above it and falling below it. In B the segments in each column are parallel, horizontal on the column x equals 1, rising to the left of it and falling to the right. In C the segments along each row are parallel, horizontal on the row y equals 1, falling above it and rising below it.
